16:The '''BYD Qin Plus''' ({{Lang-zh|c=比亚迪秦PLUS}}) is a [[plug-in hybrid]] [[Compact car|compact]] and [[Mid-size car|mid-size]] [[Sedan (automobile)|sedan]] manufactured by [[BYD Auto|BYD]] from 2021 onwards. While the first generation is a refreshed version of the Qin Pro sedan, the second generation is completely separate and only shares its name with its predecessor.

38:The '''Chery Arrizo 5''' ({{zh|艾瑞泽5}}) is a [[Compact car|compact]] [[Sedan (automobile)|sedan]] produced by [[Chery]]. The Chery Arrizo 5 received a name change to Chery Arrizo EX from 2019 to 2020 and the name was changed back to Chery Arrizo 5.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.sohu.com/a/426061691_140469|title=艾瑞泽GX又改名了！奇瑞造车没问题，真的败在营销|website=[[Sohu]] }}</ref> The Arrizo 5 also spawned a more upmarket model based on the same platform called the Arrizo 6 or [[Arrizo GX]] that debuted during the 2018 Beijing Auto Show,<ref>{{cite web|url=https://carnewschina.com/2018/09/03/highlights-of-the-2018-chengdu-auto-show-in-china-part-1/|title=Highlights Of The 2018 Chengdu Auto Show In China Part 1|date=3 September 2018 }}</ref> with the model name being changed again to Arrizo 5 Plus after the facelift in 2021.
57:From 2019 to 2020 the facelift model of the Arrizo 5 was briefly sold as the Arrizo EX with the slightly more upmarket [[Arrizo GX]] being sold alongside as a more premium option. The name was changed back to Arrizo 5 in 2020 and the Arrizo GX was changed to Arrizo 5 Plus for the facelift of the 2021 model year.

**Arrizo 5 series, 2022:** One report says the family sold 81,158 vehicles in 2022, with 45,450 sold in China and 35,708 exported. In 2021, the Chery Arrizo 5 series sold 105,189 cars. Sales in 2022 decreased by 22% from 2021, mainly due to the increasing popularity of electric vehicles (EVs) in China.

**Monthly data for "Arrizo 5":** Gasgoo's August 2022 ranking lists the Arrizo 5 at 9,904 units that month, with 53,089 units year to date. That is the non-Plus name, so it may not include the Plus. Arrizo 5 appears in that ranking, but the article doesn't break out the Plus variant.

**Naming context:** The Plus was a facelift of an earlier model. Another notes that the "hot" version of the four-door, the Arrizo 5 GT, follows the Arrizo 5 Plus, which the company has built since 2020, while the old "five" without the suffix is still in production.

**2023:** I found no 2023 China unit figure for the Arrizo 5 or Arrizo 5 Plus. The Arrizo 5 GT, a performance variant, would be available for purchase from March 28 [2023].

content.content:
At the 2019 Shanghai International Auto Show, Chery showed off the production version of the TX under the new Exeed brand. Unlike the vehicle shown in Frankfurt, this version features no Chery branding whatsoever, instead featuring a larger grille and the Exeed name written out. Alongside the standard TX, Exeed also showed off the TXL which is a 7-passenger 3-row version of the standard TX. Other than the length and wheelbase, nothing else has fundamentally changed between it and the standard TX. Production start on 24 January 2019.

**奇瑞QQ冰淇淋**
预售2.99万起 奇瑞QQ冰淇淋于今日上市的报道称，车型于2021年12月28日上市，预售价格为2.99至4.39万元。汽车之家的另一篇报道也记载了同一天奇瑞QQ冰淇淋正式上市的消息。此前新车曾因上市延期，厂方还发布了关于正常交付的公告。此后该车型还有多次改款，例如2023年8月23日新款奇瑞QQ冰淇淋正式上市。

**瑞虎7 PLUS**
2021年9月27日，奇瑞瑞虎7 PLUS正式上市，共推出9款车型，价格区间为8.69至12.39万元。它在此前的2021成都车展上正式亮相，时间为8月29日。

**瑞虎8 PLUS**
2020年10月15日，奇瑞瑞虎8 PLUS车型正式上市，共推出6款配置车型，售价区间为12.49至15.99万元。

**瑞虎9**
奇瑞瑞虎9将于5月30日正式上市，该车此前已开启预售。凤凰网汽车的报道标注日期为2023年5月31日，称奇瑞瑞虎9在北京正式上市，首批推出5款车型。

- 瑞虎9在2026年4月又推出了全新一代车型。4月22日，奇瑞汽车在北京举行「新燃油之夜」，并正式推出全新一代瑞虎9。如果你问的是2023年款，以上面的时间为准。
- 上述日期均来自汽车媒体的报道，部分报道存在预售、上市前后日期的差异。如需精确的官方日期，建议查阅奇瑞官方公告。

**结论：四款车型的首次上市时间如下（均为2018–2019年）**

1. **长安CS55 PLUS：2019年11月22日（广州车展）正式上市。** 11月11日，长安CS55 PLUS正式开启预售，新车推出4款配置车型，预售区间为9.39-11.69万元，当时官方表示将于11月内上市。在车展中正式上市的紧凑型SUV即指这款车，其报道日期为2019年11月22日。

2. **长安CS75 PLUS：2019年9月5日（成都车展）上市。** 新车推出1.5T和2.0T两种动力版本，共计6款车型，售价区间为10.69-15.49万元。汽车之家的汇总也列明上市时间：2019年9月5日，指导价格区间：10.69-15.49万元。

3. **北汽新能源EU5：2018年4月25日（北京车展）正式上市。** 据36氪报道，在2018年北京国际车展上，北汽新能源的紧凑级纯电动车EU5也正式上市，这次共推4款车型两种续航里程车型。此后2018年8月15日，北汽新能源EU5在华北区域正式上市，属于区域上市。

4. **星途TXL：2019年4月（上海车展）上市。** 在2019上海车展上，星途-TX/TXL正式上市，新车共有6款车型，售价12.59-17.59万元。另一篇报道也提到今年4月，星途EXEED TX/TXL正式上市，共分短轴和长轴两个版本六款车型。TXL是长轴距版本，与标准轴距的TX同时上市。

**说明：** 搜索结果中，CS55 PLUS和CS75 PLUS的上市时间较为一致；EU5的“首次上市”在北京车展，之后又有分区域上市；TXL与TX同步上市。若需要精确到具体日期的官方发布信息，建议查阅各厂商官网或工信部公告。

I wrote `/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-shengyin-Desktop-2026-10-10-EHL-code-Open-Trend-Tracker/3fd7f23b-806c-42e4-a247-3d41a3610973/scratchpad/cn/sales_1.json`. It covers 144 of the 164 model-years requested. The other 20 are listed under `missing` with a reason, and all 46 nameplates have a launch month.

**Sources**
- **English Wikipedia sales tables.** I read each model page's raw wikitext and summed every powertrain column for the nameplate (e.g. Han DM + EV, Qin Plus DM-i + EV, plus iDD / C-DM / EREV versions). Most cells cite Yiche's sales ranking. I labelled the metric `unspecified`. Every row's `note` gives the split and what the cell cites.
- **Yiche itself returned a captcha**, so I did not use it directly.
- **Dongchedi (insurance-registration ranking).** I used it for one gap only, Exeed TXL 2024–25 (sold in China as 星途凌云). I added up its monthly ranking data. Its history only starts in September 2023.
- **Search budget:** I used 4 WebSearch calls.

**Doubts**
1. **Mixed sources within one nameplate.** The Wikipedia tables sometimes switch source between years:
   - AITO M5 and M7 use Gasgoo for 2022–24 and Yiche for 2025.
   - Deepal S7 and SL03 use Gasgoo for 2023–24 and Yiche for 2025.
   - Galaxy L6 uses Gasgoo for 2024 and Yiche for 2025.
   - Han and Tang use chinamobil.ru for 2021–22. chinamobil's 2023 figure for these equals the Yiche figure, so it looks like the same series.
   - Yuan Plus 2022 comes from InsideEVs.
   - Aion Y 2021 comes from GoodCarBadCar.
   - For Song Pro 2022 I used chinamobil.ru (111,290). The Wikipedia cell (20,323) looks incomplete, and chinamobil's 2023 equals Yiche's.
   - Each case is flagged in its note.
2. **Possible metric.** For BYD, AITO M9, Lumin and Galaxy L6, the Wikipedia figures match Dongchedi insurance registrations exactly. For Changan and Geely they don't: Dongchedi gives 218k for CS75 Plus 2024 against 173k on Wikipedia, and 233k for Boyue L 2025 against 148k. So "Yiche" may not be one single series.
3. **Tiggo 7 vs Tiggo 7 Plus is unreliable.** The 2023 Tiggo 7 Plus figure (2,432) does not add up to the table total and is marked low confidence. Dongchedi lumps both nameplates together.
4. **Most of the missing years are 2022 for nameplates whose 2023–25 figures come from Yiche:** Changan CS55 Plus, CS75 Plus, UNI-K, UNI-T and UNI-V; Little Ant; QQ Ice Cream; Beijing X7; EU5 PLUS; SL03; Emgrand; Tiggo 8 Pro. For several of them chinamobil.ru has a 2022 value, which I put in the missing reason. I did not use those numbers because chinamobil's 2023 values differ from Yiche's.
5. **Other gaps:**
   - Chery Arrizo 5 Plus has no data for any year (2022–25). I found no model-level source.
   - Exeed TXL 2022–23 is missing; the only figures I found are production numbers that include exports.
   - Geely Binrui 2021 is missing because the only figure is from carsalesbase, a different series. Its 2022 cell is empty.
6. **Definitions I chose:**
   - Beijing EU5 PLUS is EU5 + EU5 Plus.
   - Emgrand includes the Emgrand EV and excludes Emgrand GL.
   - Fangchengbao Bao 5's Wikipedia page is now titled "Denza B5".
7. **Launch dates.** Most come from Wikipedia text or a WebSearch check. These are less certain:
   - Little Ant 2017-04, Emgrand 2009-08, Aion S 2019-05 and Aion Y 2021-04 are partly from memory.
   - QQ Ice Cream 2021-12 comes from Autohome, but sales already show up in November 2021.
   - Arrizo 5 Plus 2018-10 is the launch of its predecessor, the Arrizo GX. The Arrizo 5 Plus name only arrived with the 2021 facelift.
